name: Folate
effects: Active form bypasses MTHFR polymorphisms (~40% population has reduced MTHFR activity)
One-carbon metabolism — DNA synthesis, methylation reactions
Critical for neural tube development in pregnancy
Works synergistically with B12 in methylation cycle
May mask B12 deficiency anemia — always check B12 when supplementing
High-dose folic acid (not methylfolate) may promote undetected colorectal neoplasia in some studies
